nodes.name: Schedule Trigger — Daily 06:00
nodes.notes: Fires 06:00 America/Chicago — the timezone is set in Workflow Settings. Before 2026-10-08 no timezone was set, so it followed the server default (Asia/Manila) and the cron was never armed. Any API save of this workflow MUST be followed by deactivate -> activate, or n8n keeps the old (or no) cron registered.
